name: Structured Hiring
description: Design and run job-related, standardized candidate assessment with work samples, structured interviews, anchored scoring, and fairness auditing.

tasks.name: Analyze the job
tasks.objective: Identify critical tasks, competencies, conditions, failure costs, trainable versus must-have skills, and legal or accessibility constraints. Remove prestige proxies that are not job-related.

tasks.name: Design assessment strategy
tasks.objective: Choose a small set of complementary job-related assessments such as work samples, structured interview, technical exercise, or portfolio evidence. Define scoring before seeing candidates.

tasks.name: Build structured interview
tasks.objective: Write the same job-related behavioral or situational questions and probes for all candidates, with anchored rating scales tied to observable evidence and competencies.

tasks.name: Pilot and calibrate
tasks.objective: Trial questions and work samples, verify they elicit distinguishable evidence, train interviewers, resolve scoring ambiguities, and document scoring changes before live use.

tasks.name: Run standardized assessment
tasks.objective: Apply the same process, accommodations, questions, time, scoring rubric, and evidence capture. Score independently before panel discussion and avoid irrelevant demeanor or appearance judgments.

tasks.name: Synthesize candidate evidence
tasks.objective: Combine assessment evidence by predeclared rules, discuss material scorer differences, preserve uncertainty, and distinguish demonstrated job evidence from impressions.

tasks.name: Audit fairness and decision record
tasks.objective: Verify job relevance, consistent administration, documentation, accommodations, and rationale grounded in the defined competencies rather than post-hoc fit mythology.
